newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti expects to be out of red in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti expects to be out of red in 1998.

text.p: Troubled information and technology group Olivetti, which has not made a profit since 1990, expects a "positive result" in 1998, chief executive Roberto Colaninno told a meeting of financial analysts.
"I have not yet established the plan for 1997 which will be a year of transition...but 1998 will have a positive result," he said in reply to a question about profit forecasts.

Colaninni, who earlier said Olivetti planned to divest its PC business and three other units by the end of this year, said total divestments in 1996 and 1997 should raise between 1.0 to 1.2 trillion lire.
"In 1997 we plan to divest non-commercial activities," he said without elaborating. "The aim is to bring the company to a position where it is not eating up cash in 1997," he added.
